```{r}
num = c(2,2,3,4,3,2,1)

num |> sum()

results <- (num |> 
              sum() |> 
              sqrt() |> 
              round())
      
print(results)
```

```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)

answer <- input_vec |> mean() |> abs() |> round()
print(answer)
```
